About Our Brand & Products
Holy Cow is a science-backed gut health brand focused on human-derived probiotics and precision microbiome support. Our flagship formulas feature Bifidobacterium adolescentis — a powerful, clinically studied strain shown to support lactose digestion, reduce bloating, and improve digestive comfort. We combine cutting-edge microbiome research with simple, once-daily solutions that help people digest dairy, reduce GI discomfort, and restore gut balance naturally.

What Makes Us Different
Unlike generic probiotics, our strains are human-origin and selected for real-world digestive performance. Our formulas are grounded in emerging clinical research, not trends. We focus on root-cause digestive support — especially for lactose intolerance, IBS-type symptoms, bloating, and post-antibiotic gut repair. Clean ingredients, transparent sourcing, and real customer results set us apart.

How Affiliates Can Earn
Affiliates earn competitive commissions on every sale, including recurring subscription revenue. With strong AOV, growing subscription rates, and high customer retention, this is a high-converting offer in a multi-billion-dollar gut health market.

How to Promote Us
Share your personal experience, create educational content about gut health or lactose intolerance, review the product, or promote to audiences interested in digestion, probiotics, wellness, and functional medicine. We provide creative assets, talking points, and ongoing product updates.

Other Information
We’re expanding rapidly with new lactose, IBS, and targeted probiotic products launching soon. Join us early and grow with a brand building the future of precision gut health.
